label: Structured W256 self-attention - 2x1s input/output x59 - residual hindsight S1 x59 + R128 reset each second - TWO shared layer2 hidden512 passes per output - no layer13 - corr-gated variance +0.01 - train256k - equal batch10240 - EMA4

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: Each parenthesized number shares its exact parameters across matching blocks. Layer 2 is applied twice to the residual stream for each predicted second, with exactly shared weights. Layer 12 is one learned register initializer reset per output second, and layer 13 is absent. Layer 8 remains causal self-attention.
architecture.initialState: the first observed W embedding seeds M and P with two unnumbered GNGLUs; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: Layer 7 maps PF to NF and layer 8 causally self-attends generated NF states to emit W256. For each output second, initialize the R128+O59 stream from learned registers and that second's noisy feature sample. Apply shared layer 2 twice: concatenate the fixed W256, current stream and fixed scalar variance (444 coordinates), map through hidden512 to a 187-coordinate residual and add it to the stream. Emit the 59 sample coordinates only after pass two. Registers and samples carry between these two passes, not across predicted seconds. No hindsight, variance, decoded output, or register state enters the structured recurrence.
architecture.latentSemantics: P, F, PF, and NF remain unconstrained latent embeddings in this experiment; no probability decoder or density loss is imposed

hindsightConditioning.source: Each predicted second independently concatenates the same learned R128 initial vector with its one noisy standardized O59 hindsight sample; scalar variance conditions only layer 2.
hindsightConditioning.readout: z0 = concat(layer12, noisy_features); z1 = z0 + layer2(concat(expected_W, z0, variance)); z2 = z1 + layer2(concat(expected_W, z1, variance)); output = z2[128:]. Both calls share layer2 weights; W and variance stay fixed; full gradients propagate through z1. Reset registers and sample at the next output second; no layer13.
hindsightConditioning.initialization: Layer12 starts at zeros and is trainable; layer2 output projection starts as rectangular identity times 0.001, bias zero. Literal unit residual bypass; no learned bypass or residual-gain multipliers.

loss.description: mean MSE over both predicted output steps and all 59 feature channels after per-feature training-split standardization

hindsightNoiseSchedule.advance: check once after each complete epoch; if threshold met, increment variance once for the next epoch, capped at 1; otherwise hold indefinitely within the run epoch budget
hindsightNoiseSchedule.prediction: clean standardized features in one model forward, with two shared layer-2 residual updates per predicted second at the same noise variance; no diffusion resampling or noise-level change between updates

sampling.description: original dense chronological clean-origin dataset with exact-zero next-return targets excluded
sampling.comparisonControl: Fresh initialization with the same seed and parameter shapes as predecessor. Only change: apply shared layer 2 twice per predicted second, feeding the entire updated residual stream into its second call. Same dataset, widths, initialization scale, full-feature MSE, optimizer, noise gate, EMA and evaluation. No layer13 or cross-second register carry.

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.checkpointSelection: pure-noise validation step-1 next-return MSE and correlation; test never selects
evaluation.hindsight: All forecast evaluations use variance 1 and fixed split-specific Gaussian streams independent of targets. The training-only current-noise reconstruction probe controls the curriculum. A separate current-noise validation reconstruction diagnostic uses raw weights and a distinct seed; it does not affect the curriculum, loss, or checkpoint selection.

alignment.input: two consecutive timeline rows ending at each clean example origin
alignment.target: the two complete chronological timeline rows at origin+1 and origin+2
alignment.futureExtension: K1 uses consecutive rows ending at origin; K2 uses consecutive rows starting at origin+1
alignment.attentionCausality: output step s attends only to generated NF states at output steps <= s
alignment.hindsight: Each output step independently resets registers to the same learned layer12 vector and uses only its matching noisy O59 row. Neither updated registers nor samples carry to another output step or change W/M/P/F/PF/NF trajectories.
